title: 90% of Pro Fund Managers Lost to the S&P 500
description: According to the SPIVA U.S. Year-End 2025 Scorecard, about 90% of active large-cap funds trailed the S&P 500 over 15 years, 93% over 20 years and 79% in 2025 alone. Past results vary by period and category. Educational only, not financial advice. #indexfunds #personalfinance #shorts

title: He Bought a Closed Factory From an Ad. It Became Chobani
description: In 2005 Hamdi Ulukaya bought a shut-down Kraft yogurt plant in upstate New York with a small business loan. Chobani launched in 2007, and in 2016 he gave employees 10% of the company. #chobani #entrepreneur #shorts
